fields.name: Four Seasons Hotel Beirut
fields.description: Luxury 5-star hotel on the Beirut waterfront with stunning Mediterranean views.

fields.name: Phoenicia Hotel Beirut
fields.description: Iconic landmark hotel in the heart of Beirut, offering world-class hospitality since 1961.

fields.name: Mövenpick Hotel Beirut
fields.description: Contemporary hotel near Beirut city center with panoramic views.

fields.name: Intercontinental Mzaar
fields.description: Mountain resort hotel in Mzaar Kfardebian, Lebanon's top ski destination.

fields.name: Byblos Sur Mer
fields.description: Charming hotel by the ancient port of Byblos, one of the world's oldest cities.

fields.name: Palmyra Hotel Baalbek
fields.description: Historic hotel in Baalbek, hosting luminaries since 1874 near the Roman temples.

fields.name: Kanaan Boutique Hotel
fields.description: Cozy boutique hotel in Bcharre, gateway to the Cedars of God.

fields.name: Le Gray Beirut
fields.description: Award-winning boutique hotel in Downtown Beirut with rooftop pool.

fields.name: Em Sherif
fields.description: Award-winning Lebanese cuisine in an elegant setting, considered one of the best in the Middle East.

fields.name: Tawlet
fields.description: Farm-to-table Lebanese restaurant run by rural women cooperatives, unique menu daily.

fields.name: Liza Beirut
fields.description: Sophisticated Lebanese cuisine in a stunning 1930s mansion in Achrafieh.

fields.name: Babel Restaurant
fields.description: Rooftop dining with panoramic Beirut views, serving contemporary Lebanese cuisine.

fields.name: Leila Restaurant
fields.description: Traditional Lebanese home cooking in a warm, authentic atmosphere.

fields.name: Mounir Restaurant
fields.description: Famous grill restaurant in Zahle, known for its mezze and grilled meats by the river.

fields.name: Aleph Restaurant
fields.description: Trendy Beirut bistro blending Lebanese and Mediterranean flavors in Gemmayze.

fields.name: Mayrig
fields.description: Authentic Armenian cuisine in Bourj Hammoud, beloved for its traditional recipes.

fields.name: Baalbek Roman Temples
fields.description: One of the best preserved Roman temple complexes in the world, featuring the Temple of Jupiter and Temple of Bacchus.

fields.name: Jeita Grotto
fields.description: Stunning limestone caves with underground river, one of the natural wonders of the world.

fields.name: Byblos Ancient City
fields.description: One of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world, with Phoenician, Roman, and Crusader ruins.

fields.name: Cedars of God
fields.description: Ancient cedar forest in Bcharre, one of the last remaining forests of the Lebanon Cedar, sacred trees mentioned in the Bible.

fields.name: Pigeon Rocks Beirut
fields.description: Natural arch rock formations off the coast of Raouche, Beirut's most iconic landmark.

fields.name: Qadisha Valley
fields.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site — a sacred valley with ancient monasteries carved into cliffs.

fields.name: National Museum of Beirut
fields.description: Lebanon's principal public museum, housing artifacts from prehistoric times to the medieval period.

fields.name: Tyre Archaeological Site
fields.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site with Roman hippodrome, necropolis, and Crusader ruins.

fields.name: Our Lady of Lebanon
fields.description: Famous Marian shrine in Harissa, with a giant statue visible from Beirut and the sea.

fields.name: Sidon Sea Castle
fields.description: 13th-century Crusader fortress built on a small island connected to the mainland by a bridge.
